## 2. Core Products & Showcase

### 2.1 CoupleFlix
- **Category**: Entertainment / Real-Time Collaboration / WebRTC
- **Status**: Live & Open Beta
- **Live URL**: https://coupleflix.in
- **Summary**: Synchronized cinema and watch-together platform designed for sub-50ms audio/video sync across continents.
- **Key Features**:
  - Peer-to-peer WebRTC mesh data channels with sub-50ms playback synchronization.
  - Floating video & spatial voice bubbles for immersive watch parties.
  - Interactive timestamped reactions and synchronized emoji drops.
  - Adaptive bitrate streaming optimized for low-bandwidth mobile devices.
- **Tech Stack**: WebRTC Mesh, TypeScript, Node.js, Redis Pub/Sub, Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API.

### 2.2 SecureAuth
- **Category**: Security / Authentication / Zero-Trust
- **Status**: Production Ready
- **Live URL**: https://secureauth.govt.hu
- **Summary**: Zero-Trust authentication and identity vault built for simplicity, biometric Passkeys, and instant TOTP generation.
- **Key Features**:
  - Hardware-backed WebAuthn (Touch ID, Face ID, YubiKey) biometric passkeys.
  - Encrypted TOTP vault with cloud backup and QR provisioning.
  - Real-time anomaly risk detection engine with GeoIP telemetry.
  - Drop-in developer SDK (< 4.2 kB gzipped) for React, Vue, and vanilla JS.
- **Tech Stack**: WebAuthn, Argon2id, PostgreSQL, Node.js Express, TypeScript, Docker.

## 3. Engineering Capabilities & Services

### 3.1 Product Strategy & Architecture
- Deliverables: System Architecture Blueprints, Tech Stack Evaluation, MVP Roadmapping, Data Flow Modeling.

### 3.2 UI/UX Engineering & Design Systems
- Deliverables: Custom Design Systems, Motion & Micro-interactions, WCAG AA Accessibility, Component Kits.

### 3.3 Modern Web Application Development
- Deliverables: Single-Page & Server-Side Rendered Applications, Sub-second Speeds, State Machines, Interactive Dashboards.

### 3.4 Backend & High-Throughput APIs
- Deliverables: REST, GraphQL, & gRPC APIs, Database Optimization, JWT / OAuth2 / WebAuthn Auth, Webhook Infrastructures.

### 3.5 Real-Time & Collaborative Systems
- Deliverables: WebSockets (Socket.IO), WebRTC Voice/Video, Multiplayer Cursor & Canvas Sync, CRDT Synchronization.

### 3.6 Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- Deliverables: Docker & Container Orchestration, AWS / Cloudflare Edge Setup, Automated CI/CD Workflows, Observability.

### 3.7 Workflow & Process Automation
- Deliverables: BullMQ & Redis Job Queues, Third-Party Webhooks, Media Transcoding Pipelines, Scheduled Cron Tasks.

### 3.8 AI & Intelligent Product Integrations
- Deliverables: LLM Prompt Orchestration, Vector Embeddings & RAG Search, Automated Categorization, Agent Tool Calling.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Stack

- **Client Runtime**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion/Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Vite
- **Server Runtime**: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, WebSocket Engine, WebRTC Data Channels
- **Database & State**: PostgreSQL, Redis Pub/Sub & Key-Value Caching, IndexedDB / SQLite WASM
- **Cryptography & Security**: AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, WebCrypto API, FIPS 140-3 Standard
- **Deployment & Cloud**: Containerized Docker microservices, Cloudflare Workers edge compute, GitHub Actions CI/CD
